entities.name: Unctus
entities.description: Formerly Kiryk, a prominent Synod researcher who became Phyrexian through compleation and co-developed the Meldweb.

entities.name: Synod
entities.description: Vedalken ruling body Unctus belonged to; it forbade entering the Knowledge Pool.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: Region on whose boundary black oil was found.

entities.name: Glimmervoid
entities.description: Region on whose boundary black oil was found.

entities.name: Knowledge Pool
entities.description: Forbidden pool with a tunnel beneath that Unctus entered.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Faction that Unctus joined; its hideout is where he awoke.

entities.name: Meldweb
entities.description: A network of Vedalken and Neurok brains co-developed by Unctus.

entities.name: Scylla
entities.description: Vedalken female with similar ideals whom Unctus grafted to his body.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: Race whose biology Unctus knew well.

entities.name: Neurok
entities.description: Race whose brains were part of the Meldweb.

events.summary: Unctus, fascinated by black oil, mixes it with serum and injects himself; his body changes and he has visions of Memnarch.
events.quote: he began experimenting on himself by injecting small amounts of this mixture into his body

events.summary: After another vision, Unctus finds a way into the tunnel beneath the Knowledge Pool.
events.quote: would later find a way into the tunnel beneath after having another vision

events.summary: Unctus awakes in a Phyrexian hideout where his further compleation occurs, and he plans the takeover of Lumengrid.
events.quote: Unctus later awoke in a Phyrexian hideout

events.summary: Unctus co-develops the Meldweb, a network of Vedalken and Neurok brains.
events.quote: he co-developed the Meldweb , a network of Vedalken and Neurok brains

events.summary: Unctus finds Scylla and grafts her body to his to experience true compleation.
events.quote: He later found Scylla and grafted her body to his in order to experience true compleation.

relations.quote: was once a prominent member of the Synod before his Phyrexian compleation

relations.note: Held a prominent position in their ranks
relations.quote: put him in a prominent position in Phyrexia's ranks
